messages:
maria (AE): Hey team — enterprise prospect (FinOpsCo) asked for our SOC 2 report and a temporary assurance note. They said they need something before EOD Fri. Can we confirm what we can share without a signed NDA?

olivia (Sales Eng): Short answer: we generally require an NDA for full SOC2, but we can provide a redacted extract or a bridge letter/ack if legal signs off. Need to know what fields they care about (data residency, encryption, tenant isolation?).

sam (SE): For their POC they want to validate that we run in managed hosted mode with encrypted at-rest by default and KMS integration. If we share extracts, highlight host encryption, access controls, and monitoring. Can I get a redacted control matrix?

jordan (Legal): We can't hand over the full SOC 2 report without a signed NDA or a signed bridge letter in limited cases. I can approve a short interim assurance note + redacted control summary that omits auditor workpapers. If they need the full report, sales should send NDA. 

ash (Security): From security: we can produce a "SOC 2 extract" PDF containing scope, control descriptions, and our control-owner list, redacted where needed. We need confirmation of scope (hosted API only vs Dedicated/Private). Also specify the allowed redisclosure period. 

maria (AE): They explicitly requested: 1) encryption + key mgmt, 2) access controls + SSO, 3) incident response SLA. They also asked for a "bridge letter" template they can sign to get temporary access. Do we have a standard bridge letter?

jordan (Legal): Yes — use the internal bridge template. I pasted the template link: https://redwood-internal/legal/bridge-template-v2.pdf. Process: sales prep, prospect signs, legal countersign. For quick turnaround, mark as "limited access" and TTL 30 days. If they require longer, escalate to contracts.

sam (SE): If someone signs the bridge letter, I can provision a limited evidence bundle in an S3 bucket with presigned URLs (read-only) for 7 days. Will include: redacted SOC2 extract, config screenshots for KMS, and audit-log retention statement. deploy-bot: evidence-bundle uploaded -> s3://redwood-evidence/prospects/FinOpsCo/1779551234/ (presigned links to follow). :package:

olivia (Sales Eng): Perfect — two asks from FinOpsCo: (A) Can they get the interim extract w/in 24 hrs? (B) If they sign our bridge letter, can we get the presigned evidence links?

jordan (Legal): A) Yes, we can sign off on the interim redacted extract within 24 hours if sales attaches the exact scope and a short justification. B) Bridge letter signed -> we countersign same day normally. Please route the signed PDF to me and mention "temporary evidence access" in the email.

maria (AE): I'll send the draft NDA + scope doc to the FinOpsCo contact now. Draft scope: hosted API only, no dedicated pools; encryption by default with customer-managed KMS as optional; logs retained 90 days.

ash (Security): Note: if they ask about on-prem/private deployments, we cannot share the same extract — different scope requires separate evidence. Also, redact host IPs and internal personnel names.

sam (SE): Quick checklist for the bundle I will upload once we have signed bridge: `soc2_extract_redacted.pdf`, `kms_config_screenshots.zip`, `access_control_matrix.csv`, `incident_response_summary.pdf`. Confirm redaction rules with @jordan before upload.

jordan (Legal): Confirmed. Redact auditor workpapers, internal CI job IDs, and employee personal emails. Keep control descriptions high-level.

maria (AE): Thanks — I'll send scope + attach bridge letter to the prospect. If they sign today we should be able to share the interim bundle tomorrow morning. Tagging @olivia to coordinate the POC kickoff once we have evidence. :thumbsup:

olivia (Sales Eng): Got it. I'll stand by for the signed bridge and prepare the POC checklist (credentials, test dataset, expected SLA targets).

deploy-bot: Upload complete, bucket created, waiting for ACLs once legal confirms.

maria (AE): Filing note: FinOpsCo contact is laura@finopsco.com. timeline requested: decision by next Tue. Putting this thread in the account notes.

ash (Security): FYI — if FinOpsCo asks for longer-term retention of the SOC2 doc, we need a Data Processing Addendum + contract amendment.

sam (SE): I'll prepare the bundle and hold until @jordan gives final redaction ok. Thanks everyone.

jordan (Legal): I'll review any outgoing bundle ASAP. If anyone needs the bridge-template customized, ping me with the specific TTL and allowed redisclosure terms.

maria (AE): Closing loop here — sending scope + bridge letter to prospect now. Will update when we get the signed PDF. :spiral_calendar:
